name: AscenDEX
rootCause: Two CEX rekt in one week. Why do we see more “compromised keys” in uncertain markets? $77.7M gone from Ascendex.

descriptions.text: Two CEX rekt in one week. Why do we see more “compromised keys” in uncertain markets? $77.7M gone from Ascendex.

According to the official announcement, some ERC-20, BSC and Polygon tokens of AscendEX were abnormally transferred out of the hot wallet of the exchange, and the cold wallet of AscendEX was not affected by this incident. It is estimated that Pinnacle AscendEX’s losses totaled US$77.7 million (of which US$60 million was on Ethereum, US$9.2 million was on BSC, and US$8.5 million was on Polygon).

AscendEX suffered a hot wallet key compromise on 2021-12-11, resulting in an estimated $77 million loss across Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Polygon. Affected users were reimbursed, and the exchange moved to reinforce wallet infrastructure and security controls. A private key associated with AscendEX's hot wallet was compromised, allowing an attacker to transfer assets from the exchange's wallets across multiple chains.
